# ─── FROZEN TRANSITION COPY — do not edit ────────────────────────────────────
# The app lists moved to configurations/omarchy/ (host files + profiles). This
# file stays only for Omarchy machines whose checkout still runs the old
# omarchy-apply.sh: its post-update hook reads exactly this path from
# origin/main, and would fail every update without it. The current script
# never reads it from a commit that has configurations/omarchy/hosts/.
# Delete it once every Omarchy machine's ~/dotfiles has pulled (rh7/dotfiles#157).
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Omarchy app profile — what scripts/omarchy-apply.sh keeps installed on the
# Omarchy machines: the ThinkPad (`omarchy`, x86_64) and the M2 Air
# (`omarchy-m2air`, aarch64 / Apple Silicon). Additive only: deleting a line
# never uninstalls anything (use `omarchy pkg drop <pkg>` / Remove > Web App).
#
# Derived 2026-11-24 from rouven-m5-pro's Homebrew casks and pwas.txt, checked
# against Omarchy 4's own defaults (install/omarchy-base.packages + the web apps
# it ships), Omarchy's package repo (pkgs.omarchy.org, both arches) and the
# Arch / Arch Linux ARM indexes. Pruned by the owner 2026-11-26. NOT repeated
# here because Omarchy installs them itself: Google Chrome, Obsidian, LocalSend,
# LibreOffice, Docker, mise, Neovim, herdr, Superwhisper, mpv, Disktree, and the
# web apps ChatGPT, Grok, WhatsApp, X, YouTube, Zoom, Discord, Google apps, HEY,
# Basecamp.
#
# One entry per line, fields separated by `|`:
#   pkg     | <arch package>                       official repos or Omarchy's repo
#   aur     | <aur package>                        built by yay; not vetted by Arch
#   omarchy | <omarchy-install-* command [args]> | <package> or app:<launcher name>
#           Omarchy's own installer (adds extensions, bar plugins, services);
#           the third field is how we know it already ran.
#   webapp  | <launcher name> | <https url> [| <https icon url>]
#           icon omitted = fetched from the site.
# Any kind can be limited to one CPU architecture: `pkg@x86_64`, `webapp@aarch64`.
# Apps with no aarch64 Linux build get a web-app stand-in on the M2 Air.
#
# Prefer `pkg` over `aur`: Omarchy's repo ships prebuilt, signed copies of
# cursor-bin, slack-desktop, brave-bin, zen-browser-bin, claude-desktop,
# dropbox, spotify and (aarch64) zed — no local AUR build needed.

# ── Security / network ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
omarchy | omarchy-install-service-1password      | 1password
omarchy | omarchy-install-service-tailscale      | tailscale
# Proton VPN, Cryptomator: dropped by the owner 2026-11-26.

# ── Browsers (Chrome is an Omarchy default) ──────────────────────────────────
omarchy | omarchy-install-browser firefox        | firefox
omarchy | omarchy-install-browser brave          | brave-bin
omarchy | omarchy-install-browser zen            | zen-browser-bin

# ── Development ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pkg     | ghostty
omarchy | omarchy-install-editor-zed             | zed
pkg     | cursor-bin
# VS Code: dropped by the owner 2026-11-26 (Zed + Cursor).
# aur   | termius                                # AUR package flagged out of date

# ── AI (coding-agent CLIs come from Omarchy's mise / `omarchy agent`) ────────
omarchy | omarchy-install-ai-claude              | claude-desktop
pkg     | ollama
# aur   | lmstudio-bin                           # only if the ThinkPad should run local models

# ── CLI from modules/common.nix that Omarchy does not ship ───────────────────
# (rg, fd, bat, eza, fzf, zoxide, jq, tldr, btop are Omarchy defaults)
pkg     | github-cli
pkg     | go-yq
pkg     | age
pkg     | sops
pkg     | wget
pkg     | tree
pkg     | bottom

# ── Communication (WhatsApp, Discord, Zoom are Omarchy web apps) ─────────────
omarchy | omarchy-install-service-signal         | signal-desktop
pkg     | telegram-desktop
pkg@x86_64     | element-desktop
webapp@aarch64 | Element | https://app.element.io/
pkg     | slack-desktop

# ── Files / office ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
omarchy | omarchy-install-service-dropbox        | dropbox
# Microsoft 365 web apps: dropped by the owner 2026-11-26.

# ── Media ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pkg@x86_64     | spotify
webapp@aarch64 | Spotify | https://open.spotify.com/
pkg     | vlc

webapp  | Notion          | https://www.notion.so/
